{T}: Add {C}.

{1}{R}, Discard your hand, Sacrifice this enchantment: Draw two cards.

source_discrepancies.detail: Java returns without shuffling if chosen-card set is empty; Oracle instructs targeted player to shuffle even for zero cards. Rust proof must require the shuffle.

Java broadly enumerates all graveyard/exile cards. CR609.7a restricts departed objects to those referred to by stack/replacement/prevention/delayed objects. Rust must use the current rule source set, including permanent-spell continuation.

audit_corrections.old_claim: A prevented cost must not queue the reflexive trigger.
audit_corrections.corrected: True prohibition/no legal resource prevents paying. A legal payment modified by replacement, including replaced event, is still paid under118.11;118.12 tracks the choice to pay. Do not conflate with actual-effect mill event success. Root agreed.
